predictions.rationale: Core class that manages and dispatches all registered Critic agents, embodying the background reasoning "agency" described.
Abstract base for individual Design Critics; defines how they analyze the model and generate suggestions.
Implements the control mechanism that repeatedly activates critics in background threads.
Default implementation of the control mechanism used to schedule and run critics continuously.
Startup component that initializes and launches the critic background thread at application start.
Supports grouping multiple critics, relevant to how complex design advice is aggregated.
Registers and initializes the full set of UML-specific design critics at startup.
Holds the suggestions generated by critics; central to presenting critique results to designers.
Represents individual critique suggestions (issues) produced by critics.
Represents the active designer/user; critics analyze the designer’s work and attach suggestions to this context.
